notes: THE LEAD TEAM of the last ore train out of Morrow, dead in its yoke: two oxen at beast size, fallen the same way and staggered, the far one's stiff legs out across the tongue and the near one's back; each on its side with its legs rigid along the ground, a cream belly toward us, the head limp on the ground, a dark muzzle, big bone horns, a dun hide; the yoke beam across both necks at a slant, the tongue running off east to the wagon. Sketch B of three free sketches (art/review/morrow-kit/ox-team-sketches.png; picked by the Coordinator under Tyler's standing art sign-off, after four misses), polished palette-held by edit_image_pro_flash. Its horns stay bone pale (stone 4); the rest a step under the creatures. Pixels unscaled.
